formulas.name: Compound amount
formulas.description: Future value of a principal after periods of compounding at a rate per period.
formulas.citation: Standard time value of money identity, as in any corporate finance text such as Brealey, Myers and Allen, Principles of Corporate Finance

formulas.name: Present value
formulas.description: Value today of an amount received after periods at a discount rate per period.
formulas.citation: Standard time value of money identity, as in any corporate finance text such as Brealey, Myers and Allen, Principles of Corporate Finance

formulas.name: Annuity payment
formulas.description: Level payment per period that repays a principal over periods at a rate per period. With rate 0 it is principal / periods.
formulas.citation: Standard time value of money identity, as in any corporate finance text such as Brealey, Myers and Allen, Principles of Corporate Finance

formulas.name: Net present value
formulas.description: Sum of cash flows discounted at a rate per period, the first cash flow at period 0.
formulas.citation: Standard time value of money identity, as in any corporate finance text such as Brealey, Myers and Allen, Principles of Corporate Finance

formulas.name: Simple interest
formulas.description: Interest on a principal at a rate per period over periods, without compounding.
formulas.citation: Standard time value of money identity, as in any corporate finance text such as Brealey, Myers and Allen, Principles of Corporate Finance

formulas.name: Gross from net with a tax rate
formulas.description: Gross amount from a net amount and a tax rate, without rounding.
formulas.citation: Definition of an ad valorem tax on a net amount

formulas.name: Percent change
formulas.description: Change from an old value to a new value in percent of the old value.

formulas.name: Weighted mean
formulas.description: Mean of values weighted by non-negative weights.
formulas.citation: Definition of the weighted arithmetic mean

formulas.name: Kinetic energy
formulas.description: Kinetic energy m v^2 / 2 of a mass at a speed.

formulas.name: Gravitational force
formulas.description: Newtonian attraction G m1 m2 / r^2 between two masses. G is a measured constant.
formulas.citation: Newton's law of universal gravitation with CODATA 2022 G

formulas.name: Ideal gas pressure
formulas.description: Pressure n R T / V of an ideal gas.
formulas.citation: Ideal gas law p V = n R T

formulas.name: Body mass index
formulas.description: Body mass index in kg/m^2: mass divided by height squared.
formulas.citation: World Health Organization definition of body mass index

formulas.name: Fuel use per 100 km
formulas.description: Fuel volume per 100 km from a distance and the fuel used.
formulas.citation: Definition of fuel consumption in L/100 km
